intro: 'An Enticing Offer' is a local initiative aimed at repelling encroaching murlocs using bait concocted from toxic duskweed. By harvesting the noxious weed directly from nearby farmland, the plan simultaneously assists local growers and establishes a deterrent against shoreline pests.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I've got a few ideas on how to deal with murlocs. And one of those also helps some others in the process.

There's a weed often found on farms in the area called duskweed, and in large quantities the petals are toxic to most animals. If we make some murloc bait with the plant, hopefully that can train those creatures to stay away.
And some farmers get their fields cleared in the process. Truly a win-win... Truly a win-win.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It's pretty simple bait, but as long as nobody's pet gets into it, it should be safe. Just tell Jason not to eat any of it.
